schemaVersion: 1
authority:

        retainedKiB: 64

        page128PeakKiB: 1200

        retainedKiB: 64

        page32PeakKiB: 144
        page128PeakKiB: 336

windows.keyed-write: one public Typed or Wire keyed verb over a row its transaction already read, until transact returns: preparation, buffering, the pre-commit flush's settlement and SQL lowering, production bind adaptation, psycopg's document serialization, and the commit; no read or database execution
windows.model-preparation: one complete model preparation from the declared Entity Classes
windows.predicate-acquisition: one public tx.wire.update_until_where of a Bitemporal updateUntil, from the caller's target and changes documents through preparation and production acquisition over freshly composed resolving rows to a buffered Materialized Write Group; no flush or serialization
windows.wire-insert-response: one public tx.wire.insert of a nested, polymorphic Create Payload inside an open transaction, from the payload arriving to the frozen node it answers; no flush, lowering, or serialization
